breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth removed the incorrect periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits any mention of periodic boundary conditions and only includes the instruction to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u = 0 on the entire boundary', which aligns with the ground truth.
